edges.reason: mint uses _msgSender() as the recipient and refund target, caller controls identity
randomness is seeded with msg.sender and thus manipulable by the caller
current price depends on block.timestamp, mining-time manipulation affects price
randomness is seeded with block.timestamp, miner can influence it
mint calls _currentPrice to compute unit price
mint delegates actual minting to _mintRandom
_mintRandom calls _mintRandomIndex when the collection is revealed
_mintRandomIndex derives each index from _random
mint refunds excess ETH to the caller via external transfer
mintAllow refunds excess ETH to the caller via external transfer
buyToken refunds overpayment to the buyer via external transfer
buyToken forwards value to the external payout contract before finalizing state
withdrawBalance forwards the contract balance to the external payout contract
mint authorizes the caller by recovering the signer with ECDSA
mintAllow authorizes the buyer by recovering the signer with ECDSA
_markHashSold recovers the signer address to validate the sale
buyToken validates and finalizes the sale hash via _markHashSold
_markHashSold sets the sale hash as cancelled/finalized
mint checks and marks the order hash in _cancelledOrFinalizedSales
mintAllow checks and marks the signed hash as used
_mintRandom increments _totalMinted after minting
_mintRandomIndex reads and writes the indices swap array
mint compares _totalMinted + amount against maxSupply
mint enforces the per-transaction mint limit transactionMax
buyer parameter flows into _mintRandom for minting and balance update
amount parameter is multiplied by the unit price to compute totalPrice
signature parameter is consumed by ecrecover for authorization
buyAmount parameter is multiplied by price in mintAllow
totalPrice local determines the amount of the refund transfer
msgValue local is used to compute the refunded amount
supplyLeft local bounds the range of the random index
index local is used to look up and store replacement entries in indices
lockTokenURI derives the reveal offset from _random
lockTokenURI flips isRevealed and can only be executed once
_init writes the burnable flag controlling burn access
_init is guarded by the hasInit one-time flag
public init forwards to _init and is guarded solely by hasInit
burn requires the burnable state flag before allowing burning
_setRoyaltiesBPS validates and writes ownerRoyaltyBPS
_checkValidSigner compares against alternateSignerAddress and owner
_setRevenueShare checks the sum of bps values before writing revenueShare
withdrawBalance directs the primary payout to the owner state variable
updateVersion lets any address change its own signature version
mint validates the version through _addressToActiveVersion of the owner
ETH transfer to the caller can re-enter mint before completion
payout contract call can re-enter buyToken before state is finalized

normalization_plan.reason: amount parameter only exists as input to mint's price computation and supply checks
signature parameter is only consumed by the ecrecover authorization operation
buyAmount parameter only exists as input to mintAllow's price and limit checks
buyer parameter is only used inside _mintRandom for minting and balance updates
totalPrice local is derived inside mint and determines the refund transfer
msgValue local only feeds the external refund transfer computation
supplyLeft local only exists inside _mintRandomIndex to bound random indices
index local is produced by _random and only used for indices lookups
